theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Utilities (+0.63%) and Materials (+0.59%) led the market today, while Technology (-2.39%) and Energy (-1.96%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -1.88% versus +0.24% for defensives and -0.59% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained -1.40% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -2.47%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -1.69%. The VIX rose 18.83% to 22.91, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.38% to $3,855.30, crude oil was little changed at $85.36, and bitcoin slipped 0.31% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
